skill.author: tool-belt

security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution matches are Markdown examples rather than executable source code, but the remote pipe-to-shell installer guidance is a confirmed critical risk. The skill also documents automatic local file uploads and social media account actions, so safer install guidance and explicit user confirmations are needed.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to a shell.
remediation.suggestion: Make verified manual installation the primary path, pin release artifacts, and avoid curl to sh instructions.

remediation.issue: Local paths can be uploaded automatically to cloud apps.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation for every local path, reject parent-directory paths by default, and warn before upload.

remediation.issue: Social media actions can publish or message from connected accounts.
remediation.suggestion: Add dry-run guidance and require explicit confirmation for posts, DMs, follows, likes, and reposts.

remediation.issue: Install commands use live manifest command substitution.
remediation.suggestion: Replace shell command substitution with documented pinned artifact URLs or a signed release selector.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Local File Uploads to Cloud Apps
semantic_findings.description: The skill says the CLI automatically uploads local files when a path is supplied, including absolute, relative, and parent-directory paths. This can expose private files to remote apps if an agent selects paths without explicit user confirmation.

content.user_title: Run AI apps from your agent
content.value_statement: Agents often need many hosted AI tools, but each provider has different setup steps. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code one CLI workflow for discovery, execution, and task tracking.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation and login for the inference.sh CLI.
Lists and searches inference.sh apps by category, featured status, or text query.
Runs hosted AI apps for image, video, audio, LLM, search, and 3D tasks.
Generates sample inputs and runs apps from saved files or inline requests.
Tracks long-running tasks and retrieves generated output links.
Uploads local media paths to compatible cloud apps when users provide files.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.
External apps may require credits, quotas, or provider credentials.
Local file paths can upload private data if chosen carelessly.
Results depend on third-party app availability and current app schemas.

use_cases.title: Create media assets
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, audio, or 3D assets through hosted inference.sh apps.

use_cases.title: Prototype AI workflows
use_cases.description: Discover app schemas, create sample inputs, run tests, and track asynchronous jobs.

use_cases.title: Run research helpers
use_cases.description: Use search and LLM apps to gather information, summarize results, and return output links.

prompt_templates.title: Find an app
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to list available image generation apps and recommend one for a landscape concept.

prompt_templates.title: Run a simple job
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to run an image app for a clean product photo of a matte black coffee mug.

prompt_templates.title: Track a long task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to find a video generation app, submit a short prompt, and track the task until results are ready.

prompt_templates.title: Build a workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to search for recent AI policy updates, summarize them with an LLM app, and return the final result links.

output_examples.input: Generate one concept image for a new product landing page.
output_examples.output: The agent selects a suitable image app, submits the prompt, reports task status, and returns the generated file link.

output_examples.input: Find a video model and create a short nature clip.
output_examples.output: The agent compares available video apps, starts a generation task, checks progress, and returns the completed video link.

output_examples.input: Summarize recent search results about a technical topic.
output_examples.output: The agent uses a search app, sends the findings to an LLM app, and returns a concise summary with source links.

best_practices: Review app details and sample inputs before running a new app.
Confirm every local file path before allowing upload.
Use pinned app versions for repeatable workflows when possible.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installers to a shell in unattended environments.
Do not pass secrets, private files, or customer data without approval.
Do not automate public social actions without explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects agents to hosted inference.sh apps through the infsh command line tool.

faq.question: Does it require authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. Users must install the CLI and authenticate with inference.sh before running protected apps.

faq.question: Can it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes. Compatible apps can upload local paths, so users should approve each file before execution.

faq.question: Can it run image and video models?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation includes image, video, audio, LLM, search, 3D, and utility app examples.

faq.question: Does it replace provider APIs?
faq.answer: No. It wraps hosted apps behind the inference.sh CLI and depends on that platform for execution.

faq.question: Is it safe for social media automation?
faq.answer: It can trigger account actions. Users should require explicit approval before posting, messaging, following, liking, or reposting.
